channel.title: Humanoid News
channel.description: Independent, answer-first news on humanoid robots: Tesla Optimus, Figure, Agility, Boston Dynamics, Unitree, 1X and more.

item.title: Tesla targets end of 2027 for external Optimus deliveries, Musk says
item.description: Elon Musk said on Tesla's Q3 2026 earnings call that Tesla expects to start delivering Optimus robots to outside customers around the end of 2027, according to Electrek.

item.title: Danish grocer Føtex pilots Unitree humanoids for overnight restocking
item.description: Føtex, part of Salling Group, has started a multi-year pilot with HIVE Robots to train humanoid robots to restock shelves after closing time, ESM Magazine reports.

item.title: NVIDIA expands Isaac robotics platform as Agile Robots unveils Agile ONE SN humanoid
item.description: At GTC Berlin on 21 October 2026, NVIDIA announced additions to its Isaac robotics platform and Agile Robots announced the Agile ONE SN reference humanoid, according to NVIDIA.

item.title: South Korea grants safety-rule exemption for 20 Robros humanoids in factory pilot
item.description: A Korean regulatory-sandbox committee granted Robros an exemption so 20 of its humanoid robots can work near people at four companies' sites, Seoul Economic Daily reports.

item.title: Minerva Humanoids says it raised about $10M pre-seed led by General Catalyst
item.description: San Francisco start-up Minerva Humanoids said on 6 October 2026 it has raised about $10 million in pre-seed funding led by General Catalyst, according to its press release.
